proposition.claim:
v-c0 psi satisfies the homogeneous equation required by Proposition 6.2(iii).

The printed X space can replace the weighted Lq source hypothesis in the main theorems.

A Harnack chain gives a positive lower bound for the auxiliary u at x outside Omega_{R/8}.

The first oscillation after subtracting the source-defined average has decay exponent min(2s-n/q,1+sigma-epsilon), possibly greater than one.

The estimate includes C^1 at the critical source exponent.

The displayed variable a_x symmetric kernel class satisfies the frozen homogeneity assumption.

A supersolution is obtained from (2.2) by replacing u alone by -u.

P(x,z)=integral_Omega G(x,y)K(z,y)dy with the given L=2 p.v. normalization.

repair.content:
Supply an inhomogeneous relative-barrier estimate controlling the retained forcing, or harmonize operators and reprove the closeness step. Full repair not certified.

Use the negative support exponent to encode (3.1); alternatively formulate and prove the exact local dual scale bounds needed. The original positive-exponent extension must be withdrawn.

Propagate a lower bound for G itself on a chain staying away from the pole, or change the auxiliary domain/radii and justify all geometric regimes. Full global repair not supplied.

For noninteger exponents above one, cap the first-oscillation exponent at one; higher Campanato exponents require affine approximants. The critical integer endpoint also requires the restriction in P5.

Exclude the integer endpoint or use a justified endpoint space/weaker Holder exponent.

Impose actual frozen homogeneity, e.g. an x-independent even angular density, or weaken the claimed example.

Reverse the sign of f as well, or state E(u,varphi)>=<f,varphi> explicitly.

Insert factor 2 in (9.6), consistently with (1.1) and the inverse Green definition.
